_what: Editing this file and pushing starts a probe-battery run in Actions.
_why: Dispatching the workflow over the API needs actions:write, which the integration token does not hold (403 Resource not accessible by integration). A path-filtered push trigger needs only contents:write. Runs can also be started by hand from the Actions tab.
_loop_guard: The workflow's evidence commit writes registry/probe_runs/** and never touches this file, so a run cannot re-trigger itself.

_mode_options.catalog: GET /api/v1/models, commit the catalogue, spend nothing
_mode_options.smoke: one probe against the models named below, n=1, ceiling $1, judge off
_mode_options.full: the matrix, at n and budget_usd below
